parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be queried is 10 minutes.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description:
The information to query. You can specify multiple values and separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

- **qps**: queries per second (QPS).

- **bps**: bandwidth.

- **http\_code**: HTTP status codes.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query ISPs.

If you do not set this parameter, data from all ISPs is queried.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query regions.

If you do not set this parameter, data in all regions is queried.

parameters.name: Merge
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return aggregated data. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

The default value is **false**.

parameters.name: MergeLocIsp
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to aggregate data by region and ISP. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

The default value is **false**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
